content: Saul o Stifanore kun gorat razi aššil. Zulum He din Zeruzalemot Isayi zomator manuš okkolor uwore beša beši zulum owa šuru oiye. Henot asab okkolgun bade ar har biššaši okkol Ehudiya edde Sameriyar hár zagat šiṛa šitta oi giyegoi.
Hoekzon allawala manuše Stifanore dohon goraiye edde hiballa kub beši bilag goijje.
Kintu Saule he zomatore dongšo gori felaibar kušišot góre góre zai zomator mayafuwain edde morod fuwain okkolore ṭani ani ani ziyolot diya šuru goijje.
Sameriyat Filipor tobolig
Ze biššaši okkol šiṛa šiṭṭa oigilgoi, hitara sairo mikka giye edde kalam tobolig goijje.
He šomot Filipe Sameriyar ek šohorot zai Mosir babute tobolig goijje.
Ar beggune zara hibar hota fuinne edde ze keramoti ham okkol hibaye goijje, hin saiyore hitara hibar hota mon di fuinne.
Bout kiyor butottu napak ruh okkol sikkar mari niyoli gilgoi edde bout leng biyaraimma edde ãtur okkol aram oiye.
Henot heṛe šohorot ek ḍõr kuši oiye.
He šohorot Simon name ekzon manuš aššil, ze bout din dori heṛe zadu dehaito, henot Sameriyar manuš okkol ebbere tajjuf oi zaitogoi. Hite hitare ek ḍõr manuš fukarito.
Ar šoṛo ḍõr beggune hitar hotare dam dito edde hoito: "Allar ze kudurutire ḍõr kuduruti howa o, ite he ḍõr kuduruti."
Mainše hitar hota mozin solito, kiyollahoile bout din dori hite hitar zadu dehaiyore hitarare tajjuf gorat aššil.

Kintu Filipe zehon Allar raijjor babute edde Isa Mosir namor kušir hóbor tobolig goijje hetunot manuš okkole hibar hotat biššaš ainne, Hitara mayafuwain edde morod fuwain beggune torikotor gusol loiye.
He Simon nize o biššaš ainne, toi hite torikotor gusol loi bade Filipor fũwati fũwati gil, ar sinno edde ḍõr ḍõr keramoti ham okkol deki hite ammuwak oil.
Zeruzalemor asab okkole zehon fuinne, ze Sameriyar manuš okkole Allar kalamor uwore biššaš ainne, hetunot hitara Fitor edde Yuhannare hitarar hãse defeṛaiye.
Hitara heṛe fõsi bade, hitara Pak Ruhure faibolla duwa goijje.
Kiyollahoile hẽtte o hitarar uwore Pak Ruh no aiye. Bolke hitarare šude Isar name torikotor gusol diya oil.
Ehon hitarar uwore hat raikke, ar hitara Pak Ruhure faiye.
Kintu Simone zehon deikke ze asab okkole hat rakiyore hitarare Pak Ruhure diye, hetunot hite hitarar hãse ṭĩya ainne
edde hodde: "Ãre o ei šokti do, zene ãi o honokiyor uwore hat rakile hite he Pak Ruhure fa."
Hetunot Fitore hitare hodde: "Tor ṭĩya tor fũwati donšo ok, kiyollahoile tui mone goijjos Allar hadiya ṭĩya di kina fa.
Tottu ei hamot hono miraz otóba bag nai, kiyollahoile tor dil Allar mikka soiyi no.
Ei horafittu tui mon fira edde Mabudor hãse munazat gor. Hen oile Allaye tor dilor ei horaf sinta oitfare maf goribo.
Kiyollahoile ãi dekir, tor dil lalsiye boraiya edde tui gunar hãse kobza oi taikkos."
Hetunot Simone hodde: "Tũwara Mabudor hãse ãlla duwa goro zene tũwara zen hoiyo hendilla ãr uwore no goṭe."
Hitara Malikor babute kalam tobolig edde goba diye bade Zeruzalem firi giyegoi. Zargoide fõtot hitara Sameri okkolor bout fara okkolot kušir hóbor tobolig goijje.
Filip edde Etupiar raz hormosari
Ekdin Mabudor ek firistaye Filipore hodde, "Uṭ, doin mikkar rastat za, ze rasta Zeruzalemottu Gaza šohoror mikka giye." He rastawa aššilde bošoti sara elehat.

Toi Filipe hikka giye edde fõtot Etupia dešor ekzon has raz hormosari loi deha oiye. Etupiar Kandaki ranir dón mal dehafuna goribar bar ei manušwar uwore aššil. Allar ebadot goribolla ei raz hormosariwa Zeruzalem gil,
ar ehon górot uwafes firi zargoide fõtot, hite hitar gũra garit boi nobi Esaiyar kitab telewat gorer.
Pak Ruhuye Filipore hodde, "Oi gũra garir hãse za edde hiyanor hãse takis."
Toi Filipe dũri he gũra garir hãse giye edde funedde manušwaye nobi Esaiyar kitabwa telewat gorer. Filipe fusar goredde, "Tũi telewat gorodde hin buzo ne?"
He hormosariye hodde, "Honokiye buzai no dile ãi ken gori buzi fariyum." Hite Filipore gũra garit uiṭṭo edde hitar ḍake boibolla foriyad goijje.
He raz hormosariwaye zin telewat goijje hin oilde in:

content.text: soolor kẽš ãsoyar munttu zendilla sool suf take,
hendilla hibaye o muk no kuler.
Hiba ohomani oiye, hibar uwore niyai bisar gora no o.
Hone hoi faribo hibar bongšor hota?
zehon hibar foran ei duniyaittu loifela oiye."

content: He raz hormosariwaye Filipore hodde, "Meherbani gori ekkena hona, nobiye ei hota har babute hodde, nizor babute ne naki ar oinno honokiyor babute?"
Toi Filipe Pak kitabor he aiyatottu loti šuru goijje edde Isar kušir hóbor hitar hãse zanaiye.
Hitara fõt bai zaite zaite en ek zagat fõissegoi, zeṛe fani ase. Hetunot he raz hormosariwaye hodde, "So, eṛe fani ase, ãi torikotor gusol loite ãttu banda hoṛe?"
(Filipe hodde, "Tũi zodi zane dile biššaš goro toile tũi loi fariba." Hetunot he hormosariwaye hodde, "Ãi biššaš gori ze Isa Mosi oilde Allar Fut.")
Toi he hormosariwaye gũra gari tiya goraito hokum diye. Ar Filip edde raz hormosari, hitara dunizone fanit maze laimme. Toi Filipe hitare torikotor gusol diye.
Hitara fanittu uṛi aiššede šomot, Mabudor Ruhuye Filipore loigiyegoi, raz hormosariwaye hibare ar no deke. Toi hite kuši oiyore hitar nizor baisar uzu giyegoi.
Filipore kintu Ašdud šohorot deha giye. Ar hibaye har šohor okkolot kušir hóbor tobolig gori gori Sizeriya foijjonto giye.
